last.text: falls apart with its last key

summary: A clasp of six keys; each casts Arcane Lock on a door or container and then vanishes.
text: This clasp holds six keys. As a Magic action you can touch one to a closed door, window, gate or container to cast Arcane Lock on it; that key then vanishes, and when the last one is used the clasp crumbles.

params.text: seals a door or container shut with Arcane Lock
